problems_found.note: Expected for ICU lab data; missingness indicators handle this.
problems_found.action: No deletion. Forward-fill + mean imputation already applied. Missingness indicators preserved in X[:,D:2D].

missingness_case.explanation: preprocess.py saves X[:,D:2D] as the observed-observation mask (1=observed, 0=imputed). This is exactly the binary missingness indicator. The proposed missingness-aware TCN can use this directly. No fabrication of indicators is needed.
missingness_case.action: Baseline TCN: X[:,0:D] only. Proposed TCN: X[:,0:D] ∥ X[:,D:2D] (clinical values + mask). Both share identical imputation and scaling.

remaining_limitations: Lab features have 90-99% missingness — models must handle this via the missingness indicator approach.
Class imbalance is severe (~8% patient-level sepsis). Requires weighted loss or SMOTE on training data only.
SMOTE on flattened time-series sequences may destroy temporal structure — use class-weighted loss as primary strategy.
Raw .psv files are not included in the git repository. Audit relies on pre-computed artefacts for quantitative results.
